games.name: Bolt Skate
games.tagline: Skate or scoot five maps: flips, spins and grinds
games.description: A 3D skateboarding and scootering game in your browser. Ollie, flip, spin and grind across five maps, earn Bolts and kit out your rider.
games.longDescription: Push, carve, ollie, spin, flip and grind across five maps on a skateboard or a scooter. Play 16 levels for stars, complete quests and spend the Bolts you earn on parts and outfits in the shop. Plays with keyboard, gamepad or touch, with remappable keys and accessibility settings.
controls: Push: W or ↑ (touch: PUSH)
Steer: A / D or ← / → (touch: ◀ ▶)
Brake: Shift
Ollie: Space or J (touch: OLLIE, or swipe up)
In the air: hold left / right to spin, tap forward / back to flip, hold K for grabs
Grind: ollie onto a rail, ledge or bench edge
Pause: Esc or P · Camera: C · Respawn: R · Gamepad supported

games.name: Snapfire
games.tagline: Fast, chaotic arena shooter duels in your browser
games.description: A first-person arena shooter made in Unity. Practise 1v1 against a bot in a training facility, or host a private online duel with a join code.
games.longDescription: Snapfire is a fast first-person shooter in early playtest. Fight a bot in Practice 1v1 (first to 5 kills) inside an industrial training facility, or host a private two-player online deathmatch and share the join code with a friend. Switch between the AR-7 Vanguard rifle, the Viper SMG and the Sidekick .45. Best with a keyboard and mouse.
controls: Move: WASD
Look: mouse (click the game to capture it, Esc releases it)
Sprint: Shift · Jump: Space · Crouch: Ctrl
Fire: left mouse · Aim: right mouse · Reload: R
Weapons: 1, 2, 3
Menu: Esc

games.name: Rollforge Tycoon
games.tagline: Roll rare loot, build a factory, rebirth forever
games.description: An endless roll-and-place tycoon in 3D pixel art. Roll up an endless rarity ladder, build a production line, defend your base and rebirth.
games.longDescription: Roll for items on an endless rarity ladder, keep them in your backpack and place them on a grid to build a production line that earns money. Level up for bigger rolls, rebirth into endless prestige regions and defend your base from waves and bosses. Everything you see and hear is generated by code, your save stays on your device, and it is free in the browser.
controls: Roll once / ×10: Space / T
Open Roll, Backpack, Base, Shop and the other panels: 1-9
Place: an item's Place button, then click a tile (R rotates)
Pan / orbit / zoom: WASD or drag / Q E or right-drag / wheel
Undo the last place, move or sale: Z
Fights: M takes manual control, then WASD move, F fire, Shift dash
Touch: a touch bar while placing and a virtual joystick in fights

games.name: Riftkeep
games.tagline: Magic and Modern War hold the valley against the Blight
games.description: A free 3D tower defense game in your browser. Build Magic and Modern War towers, fight as a commander and hold the keep, solo or in online co-op.
games.longDescription: Walk the valley as a commander, build towers anywhere off the road and upgrade them down branching paths while you fight with your own hero abilities. Riftkeep has 60 maps on 14 themes, 100 towers, 200 enemies, 100 bosses and 10 heroes across 11 modes, from Campaign and Endless to Boss Rush and a Daily Challenge. Play solo or in online co-op for 2-4 players with room codes. No account, no ads, no purchases.
controls: Walk / sprint / jump: WASD or arrows, Shift, Space (touch: joystick, Sprint, Jump)
Look: right-mouse drag, or L / middle click for mouse-lock (touch: drag)
Pick a tower: 1-6 or the hotbar, then click the ground to build (touch: tap)
Upgrade / move / sell: U / M / tower panel buttons
Abilities: Z, X, G, then click to aim
Next wave / pause: N / P or Esc
Cameras: V first person, F free camera, T map overview, C back to character
